summary: Fixed the latin1 digest defect at its one shared source (inventoryOf hashed bytes.toString('binary')); shared hasher now accepts bytes, with a regression fixture whose three candidate digests differ. Published four correction records superseding originals by reference — all recomputed from retained trees, none derivational; parity correction re-derives identicalPayloads and confirms the published 33. Recorded that the factoriolab witness receipt binds record seals/bytes, not artifact digests, so it stays valid and unpublished. Added a generic Angular capability disabling optimization.fonts.inline across browser-family targets, keyed on shipped devkit schemas. Probed four Angular 16 lanes: tiny-translator and super-productivity fetched at build time; factoriolab and jira-clone clean. 1983 tests pass; no original mutated.
